dialogue_texts: First Koakuma throws a whole fit over those Grieg twins, and now I've stumbled straight into the Kozankyo Cemetery.
If I don't find the core of this magic soon, the whole festival's gonna wrap up before I even get to the food stalls.
Pack up? Oh, please. The curtains are only just rising.
A crowd this lively is exactly what the vampires ordered for tonight's grand performance.
Welcome to Kozankyo's most exclusive, quietest VIP lounge. I am Doromi Akatsuki.
Think of me as the most refined, polished dhampir you'll ever have the pleasure of losing to.
A dhampir, huh? Great, a half-baked vampire who probably hoards all the good research material.
Let me guess - you're just another member of the Order trying to ruin my night?
Affiliated? Let's just say our interests... align.
And I simply require a lively venue to test the boundaries of this parallel.
Sounds like you've been copying a certain boring shrine maiden's homework.
Either way, I'm taking that research for myself!
But out here, where the veil between worlds is as thin as my inheritance...
Your little magic tricks won't save you from the twilight.
Big words for someone who hides out in a graveyard.
My Mini-Hakkero's got more than enough kick to blast right through any 'veils' you've got set up.
Then let us see if your sparks can illuminate the dark, My Majesty.
